news.title: Few Americans Say They Are Asking AI Chatbots for 2026 Election Information
news.summary_en: Among the 8% of U.S. adults using chatbots for this purpose, most have sought information about candidates or issues in the elections.

news.title: Growing Share of Americans Say Social Media Is an Important News Source for Them
news.summary_en: A majority of U.S. adults (58%) now say social media is an important way for them to keep up with the news.

news.title: Women, Work and Caregiving Through the Arc of Family Life
news.summary_en: Gender, work and caregiving are often woven together in family life in the United States. Most parents with children under 18 are employed. news.title: Men Are Experiencing More Job Growth Than Women in AI-Exposed Occupations
news.summary_en: Men’s employment grew faster than women’s in occupations most exposed to AI, a gap driven largely by workers without a bachelor’s degree.
